<role>

</role>
<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that prospective customers want to test features like roles and tasks before signing up. None of the five most similar items address a trial or pre-signup evaluation experience: they cover workspace administration (4131), claim search filters (4128), policyholder notifications (Notion), bulk document uploads (4127), and in-progress supplier address validation (4136). No completed story or roadmap item solves the same problem, so it remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
